description: Approximate fibre location information sources is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Primary Industries and Regional Development. The Department of Primary Industries and Regional Development worked with the Office of the Government Chief Information Officer to conduct an audit of Western Australia's telecommunications infrastructure in 2017. One aspect of this project identified the approximate location of the optic fibre in the state. This information was collated from a number of sources. Coverage: Department of Primary Industries and Regional Development. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Primary Industries and Regional Development. Its tags are infrastructure, telecommunication. It offers 1 resource(s) in XLSX. The portal shows 2025-09-14 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
